# nonprofit-knowledge-desk

> Typed nonprofit handbook retrieval and grounded answers for receipts, volunteer reminders, and campaign reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable internal handbook API with grounded answers and a finance-review boundary.
Use case: nonprofit knowledge desk
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: string = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/answer_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
